common.commit: shell cd /Users/flc/PycharmProjects/rch && git add . && git commit -m '<message>'
common.clip_clear: pyexec import sys,subprocess,ctypes; subprocess.run(['pbcopy'],input=b'',check=True) if sys.platform=='darwin' else (ctypes.windll.user32.OpenClipboard(0) and (ctypes.windll.user32.EmptyClipboard(),ctypes.windll.user32.CloseClipboard()))
common.open_here: pyexec import os,sys,subprocess; subprocess.Popen(['open' if sys.platform=='darwin' else 'explorer.exe',os.getcwd()])
common.lockscr: pyexec import sys,subprocess,ctypes; subprocess.run(['/System/Library/CoreServices/Menu Extras/User.menu/Contents/Resources/CGSession','-suspend']) if sys.platform=='darwin' else ctypes.windll.user32.LockWorkStation()
common.dir_size: pyexec import pathlib,sys,math; p=pathlib.Path("<path>"); b=sum(x.stat().st_size for x in p.rglob('*') if x.is_file()); u=('B','KiB','MiB','GiB','TiB'); i=min(int(math.log(max(b,1),1024)),4); print(f'{b/1024**i:.1f} {u[i]}')
common.list_sizes: pyexec from pathlib import Path; z=lambda p:sum(f.stat().st_size for f in p.rglob('*') if f.is_file()) if p.is_dir() else p.stat().st_size; u='B KiB MiB GiB TiB'.split(); a=sorted(((p,z(p)) for p in Path('.').iterdir()),key=lambda t:-t[1]); [print(f'{n/1024**(i:=min((max(n,1).bit_length()-1)//10,4)):>7.1f} {u[i]:<3} {p.name}{"/" if p.is_dir() else ""}') for p,n in a]

win.list_av: powershell Get-CimInstance -Namespace root/SecurityCenter2 -ClassName AntivirusProduct ^| Select-Object displayName
win.list_startup: powershell Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand ^| Select-Object Name, Command, Location
win.list_ports: powershell Get-NetTCPConnection -State Listen ^| Sort-Object LocalPort ^| Select-Object LocalAddress, LocalPort, OwningProcess
win.list_services: powershell Get-Service ^| Sort-Object Status,DisplayName ^| Select-Object Status,Name,DisplayName
win.list_users: powershell Get-LocalUser ^| Select-Object Name, Enabled, LastLogon
win.list_ips: powershell Get-NetIPAddress -AddressFamily IPv4 ^| Select-Object InterfaceAlias, IPAddress
win.show_os_info: powershell Get-ComputerInfo ^| Select-Object WindowsProductName, WindowsVersion, OsHardwareAbstractionLayer
win.is_admin: fltmc >nul 2>&1 && echo Administrator || echo Not Administrator
win.show_disk_usage: powershell Get-CimInstance Win32_LogicalDisk -Filter \"DriveType=3\" ^| Select-Object DeviceID,VolumeName,@{Name='Size';Expression={('{0:N2} GB' -f ($_.Size/1GB))}},@{Name='FreeSpace';Expression={('{0:N2} GB' -f ($_.FreeSpace/1GB))}}

mac.elevate: osascript -e 'do shell script "${rch:launch_command} >/var/tmp/rchclient.log 2>&1 </dev/null &" with administrator privileges'
mac.type_password: osascript -e 'tell application "System Events" to keystroke "<password>"' -e 'tell application "System Events" to key code 36'
mac.api_url: pyexec from client.http.client_api import ClientApiClient; print(ClientApiClient().base_url)
